project: London Project - Language Beginner Vocabulary Quiz
quality_gates: Photo must depict the exact target word, not a loosely related concept.
Native-speaker audio locale must match the target language.
Validate image/audio/question/answer by shared stable question ID.
Do not silently substitute silence or a placeholder image for a failed asset.
Retry only the failed asset-generation task, with a bounded retry count.
Keep generated videos private until separately approved for publishing.
Do not mark a language batch complete until all 100 videos and 300 questions pass validation.

voice_policy.language_channels: Use one native male and one native female voice per language when configured; randomly select per video.
voice_policy.fallback: Fail the affected audio task and report missing voice configuration; never claim native audio if not produced.

image_policy.preferred: clear, real-world photograph or unambiguous high-quality illustration

notes: Language list is provisional and must be reconciled with actual channel registry before production.
This manifest records the approved specification; it does not mean 1,000 videos have been generated.
Existing scripts/topik_quiz_shorts.py is Korean TOPIK-centered and currently supports only ko, ja, en, es, vi; do not assume all ten languages are production-ready.
